majors.issue: Asphalt reads as water/canal, not road: saturated navy fill with short horizontal light dashes (the classic water-ripple convention), ragged organic blob edges like a shoreline, no curb, no kerb lip, no lane paint, no grey value. In context blue puddles sit beside/inside it and it becomes indistinguishable from a river. modern-city road is also dark but has curbs/markings; this has neither.
majors.fix: Shift to desaturated grey-blue asphalt ramp, replace horizontal dashes with aggregate speckle + crack lines, add a straight broken kerb/edge band on the mask edges, optional faded lane paint fragments.

majors.issue: Nonsense placement on the road surface: flowering green/pink bushes, weed clumps, rubble piles and pothole puddles placed in the middle of the carriageway; in settlement-4 the 3-tile-wide road jogs in a hard stair step with bushes on it, which completes the 'river with reeds' read.
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r4-C/s4-jog.png (bushes at centre/left on road, puddle bottom-left); /tmp/vqa-r4-C/rc5-jeep.png (bush + puddle + rubble on road around jeep); settlement-4 overview x480-520,y280-340
majors.fix: Restrict vegetation to road edges/cracks (small crack weeds only), no shrubs or puddle props on road cells; replace hard step jog with a bend or keep road straight.

majors.issue: Visible repeat grid at 1x: dark pit blotches recur on a regular 16px lattice in rows, so the whole ground reads as a tiled pattern (measured 64px period mean-diff 9.5 vs ~19 elsewhere on shanty-3 row y110-150).
majors.evidence: /tmp/vqa-r4-C/sh3-dirt.png (rows of evenly spaced dark blotches across the strip)
majors.fix: Add more interior variants with offset/irregular blotch positions and pick by hash, or break into larger 2x2/3x3 macro variants.

majors.issue: Shanty town does not read as a shanty town: isolated single shelters stamped on a loose grid with wide bare dirt between them, no lean-to clustering, no shared walls, alleys, fences or tarps strung between. Same shack sprite repeated in a row (shanty-3 y~210: shack, shack, shack with tents flanking symmetrically). settlement-4 uses the same scattered-stamp layout and is hard to tell apart from the shanty maps.
majors.fix: Pack shelters into dense clusters touching each other with 1-tile alleys, mix shack variants, add connecting tarps/fences/junk walls; give settlement a perimeter-wall compound identity (as settlement-1) consistently.

majors.issue: Uniform confetti scatter of the same small debris (brick piles, stones, yellow weeds, tyres) at even density over every open cell; no composition, very noisy at 1x and same across all three types.
majors.fix: Cluster debris near buildings/roads with falloff, leave quiet ground areas, cut density by about half.

majors.issue: Repeated identical stamps inside the yard: the vine block is the exact same 6x4 stamp three times (same top-right notch, same missing vine cells, same gold cell bottom-right). Both seeds also use the same kit set (winery, 3 vine blocks, barrels, press) on a bare dirt rectangle, so the quarter reads as one stamp.
majors.fix: Generate vine rows procedurally per block (length, gaps, notch varied) or use several block variants; vary quarter contents between seeds.

minors.issue: Yard spur toward the well/path stops short; a thin grass strip separates it from the path and the two dirt materials differ, so it reads as a dead-end stub.
minors.fix: Run the yard connector until it overlaps the path, or blend the end into the path tile.

minors.issue: Yard is not connected to the path (one tile of grass between path and yard top edge) and is sparsely furnished: large empty dirt area bottom-left.
minors.fix: Add an entrance connection; shrink yard or add mining props (ore carts, tailings).

minors.issue: Flagstone yard is a clean notched rectangle holding pristine temple buildings; nothing ruined spills outside (no broken columns or rubble in surrounding grass, no grass breaking through paving). Crazy paving is high contrast and busy at 1x.
minors.fix: Ragged/broken yard outline with missing slabs and grass-intrusion variants, scatter column drums outside, lower flagstone contrast by one ramp step.

minors.issue: Packed dirt is flat with a mild 16px repeat and a thin uniform outline lip; slightly less textured than the Beodeul base set.
Very small and simple; the tarp tent stamp is easy to over-repeat.
